name: stint
description: Independently managed bounded work in a session of its own: spawn a Stint, or stand up a monitor that wakes on an event, a clock, or its own rounds

interface.shortDescription: Spawn independent bounded work, or a monitor that wakes on its own
interface.longDescription: Decides whether work belongs in a session of its own at all — the test is whether this session can discharge its responsibility without receiving the completed work — and then which wake it takes: an event source, a schedule, or a session driving its own rounds to a completion condition someone else can check. From Codex the launch is fire-and-forget and is verified through the CLI.
defaultPrompt: Spawn a Stint to drive this to completion
